title: Hemoglobin-to-RDW ratio did not establish incremental FEV1 prediction beyond flexible component effects across NHANES samples
abstract: In complete-case adults40–79, adding a hemoglobin-to-RDW ratio spline to flexible component and conventional covariate models did not establish improved FEV1 prediction from NHANES2007–2008 (n=2259) to separately sampled2009–2010 (n=2474). Weighted baseline-minus-augmented MSE was -109.908 mL² (95% source+target PSU-refit interval -2362.126 to 1108.986). This model-specific negative result does not establish equivalence or refute reported HRR associations.
